data.narrative:
Blackstar is a Seed-stage AI & Software company founded by Daniel Edrisian, former OpenAI Codex engineer whose prior venture (Alex, YC W24) was acqui-hired by OpenAI in September 2025. The company has raised $12M to date. The AI & Software sector peer universe comprises 1 public company (Palantir) and 8 private peers including Figure AI, Scale AI, and Reflection AI.

Stage-progression methodology is applicable and yields a $30M valuation, derived by applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier—typical for Seed to next-stage progression—to the $12M total raised proxy. Peer-median triangulation is not applicable; while 16 same-sector peers exist, filtering for matching stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier produced fewer than three datapoints, making broad-sector median comparison unreliable.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $26M to $34M, with a median of $30M. The narrow methodological foundation reflects limited comparable data at this stage and sector specificity. Key uncertainties include revenue or usage metrics (not provided), competitive positioning relative to the specified peer set, and whether the acqui-hire precedent of Alex signals repeatable value creation or represents an outlier event. Founder pedigree and sector tailwinds are noted but do not independently justify valuation expansion beyond the stage-progression result.
